# Bridgeway, Inc.

> > Bridgeway, Inc. is an Illinois nonprofit providing integrated disability services, mental health care, crisis response, employment support, and community housing across Galesburg, Macomb, Kewanee, and Pekin.

Bridgeway offers comprehensive behavioral health services, substance use treatment, youth empowerment programs, Mental Health First Aid training, and community employment services. The organization partners with local police departments for mental health co-response and operates crisis intervention, supported living, and overdose prevention initiatives throughout west-central Illinois.

## Key Topics

- Disability Services
- Mental Health Services
- Crisis Response & Intervention
- Community Employment & Job Placement
- Behavioral Health Treatment
- Substance Use & Overdose Awareness
- Supported Living & Community Housing
- Youth Empowerment Services
- Mental Health First Aid Training
- Galesburg & Macomb Service Areas
- Mental Health Co-Responder Programs
- Crisis Services & 24/7 Support
- Community Support Services
- HIPAA Privacy & Client Rights

## Core Services

- [Homepage](https://www.bway.org): Illinois nonprofit providing disability, mental health & community services
- [Community Support Services](https://www.bway.org/services/community-support-services): Independent living & recovery services in Galesburg, Macomb, Monmouth areas
- [Community Housing and Supported Living](https://www.bway.org/services/community-housing-and-supported-living): Group homes & supported living in Galesburg, Macomb, Kewanee, Pekin
- [Youth Empowerment Services](https://www.bway.org/education/youth-empowerment-services): Youth behavioral health & family support services for at-risk children
- [Mental Health First Aid](https://www.bway.org/education/mental-health-first-aid): Mental Health First Aid training program by National Council certified staff

## Service Locations

- [Galesburg](https://www.bway.org/locations/galesburg): Galesburg office with Arch System, housing, crisis & employment services
- [Macomb](https://www.bway.org/locations/macomb): Macomb, IL office offering mental health & employment services
